newsitem.title: UK: DHL UK launches Internet web site.
newsitem.headline: DHL UK launches Internet web site.

text.p: DHL International (UK) Ltd said it has launched its own web site (www.dhl.co.uk) called 'Red Planet'.
The launch is phase one of a three-stage programme, said marketing communication services manager, Mike Bull.
He added that the company had conducted detailed research and development before putting its site on-line on the Internet.
The company said in a statement that the site would provide latest news about DHL's service network, transit times and prices, plus tracking and tracing.
Phase two of the programme would introduce video and audio facilities and downloadable software, DHL said.

Stage three would allow customers open and operate accounts with DHL. There would also be a customer magazine providing news and general information about DHL, including job vacancies within the company.
